trickyParts: The 1012 frame waits on keepAliveConn's lock and condition, never on admittedConn.mu, because revoke runs under schemaAdmissions.mu.
A revoked unanswered entry still blocks a read-only admission of its key, so the revoked page's reconnect cannot take the writable answer it holds.
The per-request answers read must not retry a no-route answer: its own 5-minute back-off is its rolling-release answer, and retrying passes its 800 ms deadline.
